method: Opened all five saved workspace PNGs at original resolution with local view_image; no browser or Playwright.
Verified dimensions, aspect ratio and SHA-256 after workspace copy.
Checked individual role evidence, Series locks, material physics, food plausibility, people/tool contact and exclusions.

series_checks.evidence: Pale-mineral, off-white ceramic, brushed stainless, upper-left daylight and restrained warm-neutral grade remain coherent across five frames.
Raw atlas, six bases, 3x3 raw-base-trace matrix, straining and folding advance one observable state per role.
No generated text, labels, arrows, packages, apothecary grid, perfume, cosmetics, spirits, labware, kraft or rustic trade dress.
No numeric process data, ingredient origin, health, nutrition, sustainability, handmade, small-batch or validated-SOP claim appears.

checks: native 4:3 and true 90-degree overhead
exact 2x3 six stations: thyme+honey, isolated Fig Leaf direction, buckwheat, citrus peel, black sesame, olive oil+actual-scale salt
no label, seventh group, whole citrus, oversized salt or decorative prop
single-source shadows and consistent overhead vessel perspective
native 3:2 strict frontal workspace
exact six bowls and comparable baseline
viscous syrup, pale aqueous prep, fine slurry, filtered citrus prep, opaque paste and oil phase are materially distinct
no glass drinking vessel, whiskey/spirit cue, labware, strainer or cloth
native 4:3 elevated oblique
exact 3 rows x 3 columns and no tenth group
Thyme Honey, Citrus Peel and Black Sesame each read raw-to-base-to-finished left to right
no invented text, arrow, grid line, package or garnish substitution
native 3:2 strict maker-right one-eye side profile
dense concentrate, muslin, perforated frame, three gravity drip paths and pale acid whey share one vertical axis
hands only steady frame; no squeezing, press, pump or invented equipment
same maker/charcoal wardrobe continuity and generic production-role reading
native 3:2 tight 3/4 detail
plain measured-base cup, broad paddle, dense standing ridge and one retained amber-thyme trace all visible
one fold only; no simultaneous pour, whisk, mixer or extra action
face cropped, hands and bowl contacts plausible, no founder reading

residual_gates: Fig Leaf species, part, preparation, supplier batch, latex/furanocoumarin risk and market legality remain unresolved; do not caption the visual as proof of edible suitability.
Actual R&D samples must replace or validate every food color, particle, viscosity, phase, separation and retained-trace appearance.
Straining image does not establish duration, yield, whey disposition, temperature, pH, sanitation plan or equipment specification.
Folding image does not establish dose, shear rate, mixing time, batch size, recipe or SOP.
Generated maker is not founder, employee or production-source evidence and requires no biographical caption.
